DA.Title: Dominion Aetherics Sheet
DA.DeleteElementConfirm: Delete this world element? Active selections will be cleaned up. Powers referencing it will be locked until their requirements are updated. Power Items and other Actor data will be preserved.
DA.RegistryHelp: World elements are shared definitions. Each character keeps its own selection. Create any chemical, artificial or fictional element here.
DA.NoElements: No elements defined. The GM can create them in the Element Manager.
DA.NoPowers: No powers in this group. Add a Power using the system control above.
DA.NoActivePassives: Select an element to display its passives.
DA.GraphHelp: Select elements on the left. Click an unlocked power to open its SWADE chat card. Edit or configure powers with the small buttons or right-click menu. Hover a node to see connections.
DA.Name: Name
DA.MechanicalPassive: Managed Active Effect; applied while this element is active.
DA.EffectHelp: Choose a correctly configured Foundry/SWADE Active Effect, then Add. The module stores a GM-approved snapshot and manages one Actor effect per source UUID, even when several elements share it. Timers are not copied; passives last while selected. Re-add a source to refresh its snapshot after editing the original.
DA.EffectUUID: Or paste an Active Effect UUID (world or compendium)
DA.RecipeHelp: Each combination requires all of its checked elements. Any one combination can unlock this power. A checked configuration with one empty combination explicitly means always available (subject to forbidden/exact rules). Uncheck configuration to mark it Unconfigured.
DA.ExactHelp: Normally extra selected elements are allowed. Exact mode requires the selection to equal one valid combination.
DA.InvalidRecipe: This power references a removed element or unsupported requirements. The GM must update its configuration.
DA.PowerLocked: This power's elemental requirements are not satisfied.
DA.GMOnly: Only a GM can configure world elements and Power requirements.
DA.NoPermission: You do not have the required document ownership permission.
DA.WrongActor: This Power does not belong to the selected Actor.
DA.ElementNameRequired: An element name is required (maximum 100 characters).
DA.InvalidImage: Use a Foundry image path or an HTTPS image URL.
DA.InvalidPassive: Each descriptive passive needs a title and description.
DA.InvalidEffect: Select an existing Active Effect or enter its valid UUID.
DA.ManagedSource: Choose an original source effect, not a module-managed copy.
DA.RelatedEffectSource: This status effect automatically creates related effects. Use independent passive effects and assign each component separately so their removal can be tracked safely.
DA.InvalidSelection: Selection contains an unknown element ID.
DA.SelectionLimit: The GM allows at most {count} active elements.
DA.InvalidRequirements: Requirements need at least one valid combination. Removed, duplicate, conflicting or unknown element IDs are not allowed.
DA.InvalidSchema: Element registry has an unsupported schema. Do not overwrite it; restore a compatible module version.
DA.UnsupportedVersion: Dominion Aetherics requires Foundry V13 and SWADE exactly 5.1.0. The optional sheet was not registered; existing sheets are unaffected.
DA.UnsupportedTemplate: The installed SWADE Powers template is incompatible. Showing the original sheet contents.
DA.MaxActiveHelp: 0 allows unlimited selections. A positive number sets a world limit.
DA.SeparateUnconfigured: Show unconfigured powers in a separate group
DA.Connections: Show connections on hover or focus
